summary: Bounded byte accessor: returns the byte at this[a2 + 852] when a2 is below 0x68, otherwise returns 0. Called from terrain surface roughness/height sampling, so this is a read into a per-index data table with a hard size cap of 0x68 entries.

operations.description: if (a2 >= 0x68) the index is out of range; fall through to return 0
effective offset = a2 + 852 into the this array

unresolved: Meaning of the 852-byte base offset and the 0x68 element count is not established.
The this object type (terrain surface data owner) is unknown.
Whether the returned byte is roughness, height, or another per-cell quantity is unproven.
